title: Failed AWS IAM user creation attempt
description: arn:aws:iam::111122223333:root attempted to create an IAM user but the action was denied.
recommended_action: Validate whether the actor was authorized to create IAM users. Review CloudTrail activity before and after the denied request.

title: Azure RBAC role assignment changed
description: analyst@example.com successfully changed an Azure role assignment.
recommended_action: Identify the principal, role, target scope, and change ticket. Revoke unexpected access and investigate related Azure activity.

title: Possible DLL search order hijack
description: Wazuh reported rule 92219 on Windows-wazuh. Review the process, DLL path, signature, and surrounding events before deciding whether it is malicious.
recommended_action: Validate the executable signature, inspect the DLL hash and path, and correlate parent-child process activity before escalating.
